connector.name: EU VAT Validator (VIES)
connector.registryDescription: Bulk-validates EU VAT numbers against the European Commission's official VIES service.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.apify.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the apifymcpfactory-droid account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Apify API token as 'Bearer <token>'. Optional if your MCP client supports OAuth.
